Common questions about Meetily's SEC & FINRA compliance, financial data protection, and regulatory features

children.q: How does Meetily support SEC 17a-4 and FINRA record-keeping?
children.a: Meetily produces immutable local recordings and timestamped transcripts of client and advisory meetings, which can be archived under your existing WORM-compliant storage to support SEC Rule 17a-4(f) electronic record requirements and FINRA Rule 4511 record-retention obligations. Compliance is implemented by the firm's record-keeping policy and storage layer; Meetily provides the audit-grade source artifacts. We do not claim independent SEC or FINRA certification - those are firm-level designations.

children.q: Does Meetily support MiFID II call recording for European advisors?
children.a: Yes. MiFID II Article 16(7) requires recording of communications that result in or may result in a transaction. Meetily records and transcribes client investment meetings 100% on the advisor's device, with the recording artifact retained under the firm's MiFID II retention policy (5 years, extensible to 7 by national regulator). Combined with on-device processing, the recording stays within the firm's control - no third-party cloud processor is in the loop.

Meetily is not formally SOC 2 certified - the architecture supports SOC 2 controls (access control on Enterprise, audit logging, encryption in transit and at rest), but no current third-party attestation report exists. For institutions that require a SOC 2 report from the vendor, our recommendation today is the self-hosted Enterprise deployment, which puts the trust boundary inside your existing audited environment.

children.q: What security measures protect financial data?
children.a: Transcription runs locally on the advisor's own device, so recordings and transcripts are never sent to Meetily - there is no server of ours holding them. Role-based access control, detailed audit trails, and compliance flagging come with Enterprise, where meetings are stored centrally on your own infrastructure.

children.q: Can Meetily be used for client advisory meetings?
children.a: Yes, Meetily is ideal for client advisory meetings. It provides secure, compliant documentation while maintaining complete confidentiality. The system handles investment reviews, advisory sessions, and client consultations with full regulatory compliance.

Data sovereignty is maintained through local processing - all data processing happens within your own infrastructure, not on external servers. This ensures complete control over client information and compliance with financial regulations.

children.q: What compliance features are built into Meetily?
children.a: Enterprise deployments add automatic audit trails, retention policy enforcement, role-based access control, compliance flagging, and detailed activity logging, running on your own infrastructure. That architecture is built to support SEC Rule 17a-4 and FINRA record-keeping requirements - Meetily is not certified against them, and the controls remain your firm's to configure and evidence.
